content: Lineage 2 User and License Agreement (4game/EU, v10 Apr 2026) prohibits developing/using/distributing cheats, bots, hacks, mods or unauthorized third-party software that modifies the game experience, grants unfair advantage, or interferes with the service/client; also prohibits disabling/circumventing security and authentication technology (Frost). L2 ships GameGuard historically and Frost more recently, which prevent third-party software from loading into the game process. Screen-only reading (no injection, no memory read, no input synthesis, no packet manipulation) does not load into the process and is closest to the OBS Display Capture pattern that anti-cheat does not block. Risk is not zero because anti-cheat heuristics are opaque and private servers set their own rules, but it is categorically lower than memory reading or input automation. No source found stating screen reading is explicitly permitted.
